title: KPop Demon Hunters
about: A K-pop girl group who secretly hunt demons face a rival boy band with a dark secret.

HUNTR/X Tour BackstageKPop Demon HuntersRamyeon first, then concert night.Every recipe serves 4.
    StartersMainsSweetsDrinks
    StartersCarb-loading kimbapSushi rice and nori rolls with omelette, carrot and vegetablesHow to make it300g sushi rice1 tsp sesame oil4 nori sheets2 eggs2 carrots200g spinach100g pickled radishSeason the cooked sushi rice with sesame oil and salt.Lay rice on the nori sheets, add strips of omelette from the eggs, sautéed carrot, blanched spinach and pickled radish, then roll tightly and slice into rounds.Saja Boys' sugar-dusted hot dogsFrankfurter and mozzarella skewers, battered, fried, then ketchup and mustardHow to make it8 frankfurts200g mozzarella250g self-raising flour1 egg1 bag caster sugar250ml full cream milk100g panko breadcrumbs1 bottle tomato sauce1 bottle American mustard1 L vegetable oil8 bamboo skewersThread the frankfurts onto skewers with a stick of mozzarella above.Whisk the self-raising flour, the egg, the sugar and the milk into a thick batter, pour into a tall glass, dip each skewer and roll in the panko.Fry in the vegetable oil at 170°C for 4 minutes, roll in sugar and drizzle with tomato sauce and mustard.MainsPre-game ramyeon with eggPre-game ramyeon: spicy ramen, kimchi, egg and cheeseHow to make it2 tbsp gochugaru2 tbsp soy sauce4 packets of ramen noodles4 eggs200g kimchi3 spring onions4 slices of American cheese2 L waterBring the water to the boil with the gochugaru, the soy and a stock cube.Cook the ramen noodles for 3 minutes, crack in the eggs and cover 1 minute.Divide into bowls with the kimchi, sliced spring onions and a slice of cheese melting on top.Comfort night beef bone soupBeef bone soup. Mira finally finishes a meal.How to make itAs written, serves 4Milky beef bone broth simmered for hours, with sliced brisket, rice and noodles, seasoned at the table with salt and spring onion, radish kimchi alongside.Soak 2kg beef marrow bones and 600g brisket in cold water for 1 hour.Boil the bones 10 minutes, drain and rinse.Cover with 4L fresh water, boil hard with the lid off for 3 hours, topping up, until milky.Add the brisket for the last 90 minutes, then slice it thin.Cook 100g somyeon noodles.Serve bowls of broth with brisket, noodles, cooked rice, sliced spring onion, salt and pepper to season, and 300g radish kimchi.SweetsCinnamon walnut hotteokChewy fried yeast pancakes filled with brown sugar, cinnamon and walnutHow to make it300g plain flour7g dried yeast1 tbsp caster sugar220ml milk80g brown sugar1 tsp ground cinnamon40g walnutsMix the flour, the dried yeast, the sugar and the warm milk into a sticky dough and prove 1 hour.Fill the balls with the brown sugar, the cinnamon and the chopped walnuts, flatten in an oiled pan and fry 2 minutes a side until crisp.DrinksGolden honey yuja teaGinger, yuja citron and honey tea with lemon, hot or icedHow to make it1 knob ginger1 jar yuja citron tea2 tbsp honey1 lemon1 L waterSimmer the water with a 3cm knob of ginger, sliced thin, for 5 minutes.Take off the heat and stir in the yuja citron tea and the honey until dissolved.Pour into heatproof glasses, making sure each gets some citron peel, and add a thin lemon slice.For an iced version, cool it and pour over ice.
